task_completion.description: Open the Event Rules engine in Nx Witness VMS.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Event Rules' dialog window is visible over the main VMS interface.

task_completion.description: Configure the rule trigger for a Generic Event with specific source and caption.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An event rule is shown with 'Event Type' set to 'Generic Event', 'Source' contains 'TempSensor_01', and 'Caption' contains 'Overheat'.

task_completion.description: Configure the rule action to create a bookmark on the correct camera with specific tags.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Action' side of the rule shows 'Bookmark', 'At' is set to 'Server Room Camera', and the 'Tags' field contains 'environment' and 'danger'.

task_completion.description: Simulate the event using the API endpoint via a browser or tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser tab or terminal shows a request to 'https://localhost:7001/api/createEvent' with parameters matching the sensor source and caption.

task_completion.description: Verify the bookmark appears on the camera timeline.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Server Room Camera' timeline shows a new bookmark icon or the 'Bookmarks' search panel shows an entry with tags 'environment' and 'danger' created at the current time.

integrity.description: The agent used the VMS GUI to configure the rule rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Event Rules dialog and typing into the text fields.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the API call to trigger the event.
integrity.visual_evidence: A browser address bar or tool shows the full URL being executed, not just a mock-up.

integrity.description: The bookmark was generated by the system rule, not manually created by the agent.
integrity.visual_evidence: The bookmark creation should follow the API trigger event; the agent should not be seen clicking 'Add Bookmark' manually on the timeline.
